item.title: Parish Council OKs $500,000 for Bayou Vista drainage
item.description: Staff report The St. Mary Parish Council on Wednesday passed a long-delayed allocation for drainage improvements in Bayou Vista. But the wait for improvements isn’t over yet.

item.title: Galatea, Amani kids up next for Mardi Gras
item.description: Jamie Heyl Photography King and Queen Galatea LVI Wayne Mayon Sr. and Angela Kraemer were crowned at the 2025 Galatea ball and tableau. Cre Jenay Photography King Jamal Harvey Jr. and Queen Blair Nash reigned at the 2025 Krewe of Amani Kids ball. The Krewe of Galatea and the Amani Kids Krewe take their respective stages Saturday as East St. Mary’s Mardi Gras celebration winds closer to the big day.

item.title: Nicholls names honors program for Morgan City's Miller
item.description: Nicholls State's honors program, directed by Dr. Brigett Scott, has been named for Morgan City's Robert E. "Bob" Miller. Nicholls photo To honor longtime Nicholls Foundation board member and university donor Robert E. “Bob” Miller, Nicholls State University has named its honors program the Robert E. Bob Miller Honors Program.

item.title: Qualifying Feb. 11-13 for special Morgan City Council election
item.description: Qualifying will be Feb. 11-13 for offices up for a vote May 16, including a special election to fill a Morgan City Council seat.

item.title: Morgan City man at large after escape from East Carroll jail
